latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Agent Browser: a fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI.

- Automate web navigation, clicks, typing, and snapshots using structured commands.
- Supports both Rust core and Node.js fallback.
- Includes commands for interaction, data extraction, screenshots/PDF, video, mouse, network, and storage control.
- Features semantic locators, frame/tab management, and state saving/loading for sessions.
- Ideal for programmatic form filling, UI testing, and complex web automation tasks.
